description: EV DORA Regulation — Sentinel alert rules for azure (SIEM-alert-rules)

rules.name: AI — Governance — Missing Risk Assessment
rules.description: Detects AI system operations without documented risk assessment per EU AI Act Article 9
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "governance" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-GOV-001

rules.name: AI — Direct Prompt Injection
rules.description: Detects direct prompt injection attempts overriding system instructions via user input
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "direct" or Message contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-PI-001

rules.name: AI — Indirect Prompt Injection via External Data
rules.description: Detects prompt injection payloads embedded in uploaded files, web pages, or external data sources
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "indirect" or Message contains "prompt" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-PI-002

rules.name: AI — RAG Pipeline Data Poisoning
rules.description: Detects injection of malicious content into RAG knowledge bases that corrupts retrieval output
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "rag" or Message contains "pipeline" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-AI-RAG-001

rules.name: MySQL — UNION-Based SQL Injection
rules.description: Detects UNION-based SQL injection attacks against MySQL databases
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "mysql" or action_name_s contains "union" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 5 // AZ-DB-MY-001

rules.name: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "postgresql" or action_name_s contains "privilege" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 5 // AZ-DB-PG-001

rules.name: Search Engine Discovery of Sensitive Content
rules.description: Detects search engine crawlers accessing sensitive paths like /admin, /.env, /.git, /wp-admin, /backup, /config
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "search" or Message contains "engine" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-001

rules.name: Web Server Fingerprinting via Headers
rules.description: Detects verbose server headers disclosing technology stack versions enabling targeted attacks
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "web" or Message contains "server" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-002

rules.name: Directory Listing Exposure
rules.description: Detects directory listing responses exposing file structure and sensitive files
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "directory" or Message contains "listing" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-004

rules.name: Metadata and Source Code Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to metadata files and source code repositories exposing implementation details
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "metadata" or Message contains "source" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-005

rules.name: Error Message Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error messages leaking stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "error" or Message contains "message" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-006

rules.name: Sensitive Data in URL Parameters
rules.description: Detects sensitive data such as tokens, passwords, and PII transmitted in URL query parameters
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "sensitive" or Message contains "data" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-007

rules.name: CORS Wildcard Origin Misconfiguration
rules.description: Detects CORS headers with wildcard origins or origin reflection enabling cross-origin data theft
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cors" or Message contains "wildcard" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG01-009

rules.name: Credentials Transmitted Over Unencrypted Channel
rules.description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "credentials" or Message contains "transmitted" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-001

rules.name: Default Credentials Usage on Login
rules.description: Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "default" or Message contains "credentials" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-002

rules.name: Account Lockout Mechanism Failure
rules.description: Detects more than 20 failed login attempts for a single account without lockout indicating weak lockout policy
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "account" or Message contains "lockout" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-003

rules.name: Directory Traversal Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects path traversal attempts using ../ sequences or encoded variants to access files outside intended directories
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "directory" or Message contains "traversal" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-011

rules.name: Authorization Schema Bypass via Role Manipulation
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass authorization by manipulating role parameters in API requests
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "authorization" or Message contains "schema" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG04-012

rules.name: SQL Injection Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in HTTP requests including UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, and comment-based injection
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "sql" or Message contains "injection" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG07-001

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Reflected
rules.description: Detects reflected XSS patterns in HTTP request parameters including script tags and event handlers
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cross" or Message contains "site" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG07-002

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Stored
rules.description: Detects stored XSS patterns where malicious scripts are persisted and served to other users
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cross" or Message contains "site" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG07-003

rules.name: DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting
rules.description: Detects DOM-based XSS patterns where client-side JavaScript renders user input unsafely
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "dom" or Message contains "based" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG08-001

rules.name: SSRF to Internal Services and Cloud Metadata
rules.description: Detects SSRF requests targeting internal services, localhost, and cloud metadata endpoints
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "ssrf" or Message contains "internal" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG09-001
